meals.ingredient_statement: Make this Thanksgiving all about connection and indulgence without the stress of endless prep and cleanup. Factor’s luxurious meal for two kicks off with a tender chicken breast. Our chefs’ take on green bean casserole lightens things up, with roasted green beans crowned by hearty portobello mushrooms. You’ll also enjoy creamy butternut squash mac ’n’ cheese, rich with smoky gouda for a decadent twist. Fluffy brown butter mashed potatoes are served with a silky rosemary-thyme gravy that ties the entire feast together. Don’t forget the cranberry sauce! Ours pops with zesty orange, ginger, and cozy spices, and is sweetened naturally with date syrup. And because no holiday meal is complete without dessert, we finish off with two creamy & rich pumpkin spice single-serve cheesecakes. Made with pumpkin, coconut sugar, and warming spices such as ginger, cinnamon, and cloves. Wishing you a warm and joyous Thanksgiving from Factor! You’ll also enjoy creamy butternut squash mac ’n’ cheese, rich with smoky gouda for a decadent twist. Fluffy brown butter mashed potatoes are served with a silky rosemary-thyme gravy that ties the entire feast together. Don’t forget the cranberry sauce! Ours pops with zesty orange, ginger, and cozy spices, and is sweetened naturally with date syrup. And because no holiday meal is complete without dessert, we finish off with two creamy & rich pumpkin spice single-serve cheesecakes. Made with pumpkin, coconut sugar, and warming spices such as ginger, cinnamon, and cloves. Wishing you a warm and joyous Thanksgiving from Factor!
